  n P n           ≡⟨ nPk≡n!/[n∸k]! (≤-refl {n}) ⟩

  n P 1          ≡⟨ nPk≡n!/[n∸k]! (s≤s (z≤n {n-1})) ⟩

    _ = k !* (n ∸ k) !≢0
    _ = (n ∸ k) !* (n ∸ (n ∸ k)) !≢0
